claims: - **Tidal dwarf galaxies.** A gas-rich major merger on a forward orbit throws out long tails. Clumps in them become small galaxies with no dark matter. Most fall back within a few Gyr (Bournaud and Duc 2006, doi:10.1051/0004-6361:20065248).
